author: Ryan Daws
description:
Google has released Gemma 4 12B, an open-weights model designed to execute complex, multimodal AI workloads directly on standard laptops. This enables agentic AI workflows that operate with zero network latency on local data, addressing core enterprise concerns around privacy, cost, and responsiveness. title: Google’s Gemma 4 12B brings local multimodal AI to laptops
